You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#26066, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone — read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` before your first edit, and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read this card's full body and every comment yourself (REST: `curl -sS -X GET "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/26066" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`).

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; it names your thread's branch in its `Branch:` line. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names the branch your thread was given (`claude/project-thread-…`); if no claim names it yet, send the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 one message with your branch name and wait for the claim. Work in a worktree of your own clone (`git worktree add ../objectstack-issue-26066 <your-branch>`, `git merge --ff-only origin/main`, `pnpm install` detached with `nohup … &` and `tail --pid`; record `BASE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)`); push only that branch, ⛔ no force.

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, draft forced, `assignees: ["os-warren"]`, `labels` with `skip-changeset`); comments, labels and bodies only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`, `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`, `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`. ⛔ GitHub MCP writes of every kind. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names).

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

The maintainer's words in the card body (10:43–10:50Z) and, after the card, in the project chat, verbatim: 「os-zhuang」 (2026-10-26T15:01Z) 「os-zhuang 或 hotlong」 (2026-10-26T15:01Z) — the logins behind his "Merge when ready" click, both already in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`. Triage audit 6415485094 fixes the boundary, verbatim: "Only the `merge_group` leg of `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` accepts 'enqueued by an authorized account' in place of an APPROVED review. The authorized set does not grow, and an enqueue by any other account still needs the review. The guard's `--self-test` pins both. The AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14 sentence changes in the same governed PR, which lands by the maintainer's hand."

### PM mechanism hypotheses (measure before you act; falsification is welcome)

Read on `origin/main` `dfaad4da`, 2026-10-26T15:30Z:
1. The predicate lives in `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`: `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` at the `export const` near line 621, the `merge_group` leg's approval predicate around lines 1160–1180, the header's regime text lines 36–100. The card body's "What to change" §2 names two candidate readings of the enqueuer (`GET /pulls/N` → `auto_merge.enabled_by.login`, or the newest `added_to_merge_queue` timeline event's `actor.login`): measure both on a real queued governed PR before choosing; prefer the one the guard can read with the token it already holds in the `merge_group` run, and say in the report which you measured and what each returned.
2. `AGENTS.md:281` and `:518` are the two sentences that say "an authorized APPROVED review" is the queue landing's word; change only what the ruling changes (the enqueue by an authorized account is the other acceptable review record), in the file's own register. `AGENTS.md` is Tier H: the PR lands by the maintainer's hand; you never ready, arm or enqueue it.
3. The self-test (`node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`) pins the predicate as a table; add the two new rows (authorized enqueuer passes without a review; unauthorized enqueuer without a review still refuses) beside the existing ones, keeping every existing row.

### Card-specific clauses

- Tier H (AGENTS.md hit ⇒ the whole PR). The PR is created **draft** with `## 维护者速读(草稿)` (Chinese, business angle, 席位意见 left empty) and stays draft; the seat posts the contract review and hands it to the maintainer. ⛔ Never ready it.
- `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` go line-initial into the PR body after the first line `Fixes #26066`. `skip-changeset`: nothing published ships from `scripts/pm/**` or `AGENTS.md`.
- Gates: derive with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) on your final tree, run each locally (exit code captured before any pipe), reconcile with `--ran`. At least the guard's `--self-test`, `pnpm lint` and `pnpm check:governed-queue-guard-self-test` (or the family `--commands` prints for the file) must be green; long gates detached. Heavy commands through `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` with `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=issue-26066`.
- Commit trailers: the model-free pair exactly as `os-dev.md` / `AGENTS.md` spell them; ⛔ no model name anywhere in the commit or PR.
- Hand-back: post the `os-dev-report` JSON as a comment on this card (first line `os-dev-report`) through `post-stamped.mjs --comment=26066`, then send the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 one message: PR number, head sha, and the report's `status`. Keep your thread open for a patch round. ⛔ Do not wait for CI after the PR opens.
